correctness.rationale: For every even n>=4, forcing successive mutual-first pairs reduces to the only two partner-demoting swap cases. Odd-indexed deviator yields one uniquely stable modified four-person block; even-indexed deviator produces a 3-cycle no matching can stabilize. All remaining cases retain the unique canonical matching. Exact \(1/(2n)\) follows from count n(n-2). Independent finite exact program checks all 8+24+48+80 perturbations through n=10; those tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A single adjacent swap is the minimal Kendall preference perturbation around a natural common-priority ranking. A complete all-size robustness threshold distinguishes loss of existence, changed unique solution, and unchanged unique solution; exact risk \(1/(2n)\) quantifies fragility under uniform one-error measurement. This structural classification is motivated independently of the computation and goes beyond arbitrary small counterexamples.
